policy: Lifecycle status and evidence strength are separate dimensions.
No incubating skill may be promoted without new post-creation evidence.
Observational evidence may retain an existing stable/project lifecycle but is not causal effectiveness proof.
Phase 16 prefers deletion or consolidation over adding new machinery.
Historical evidence artifacts are preserved unless they are exact duplicates or nonfunctional.
